class.name: FSMethodDescriptor
class.brief_description: A read-only structured descriptor for a single reflected [FoundryScript] method.
class.description: Describes one method declared by a [FoundryScript] type or its base scripts, as a typed alternative to the loosely-keyed [Dictionary] entries of [method FSReflection.get_methods]. Instances are produced by [method FSReflection.get_method_descriptors] and [method FSReflection.get_method_descriptor] and are immutable snapshots of the compiled method metadata. Beyond the [method Object.get_method_list] fields it mirrors ([member name], [member args], [member return_value], [member default_args], and [member flags]), each descriptor carries the method's passive [member annotations] and the exact declared types of its signature ([member arg_type_names] and [member return_type_name]). The accessors return copies, so mutating them does not change the script's stored metadata. Use [method to_dictionary] to obtain the equivalent loosely-keyed descriptor [Dictionary].

method.name: to_dictionary
method.description: Returns the equivalent loosely-keyed method descriptor [Dictionary], matching the entries of [method FSReflection.get_methods]: an [method Object.get_method_list] [Dictionary] plus [code]"annotations"[/code], [code]"arg_type_names"[/code], and [code]"return_type_name"[/code] keys holding the [member annotations], [member arg_type_names], and [member return_type_name].

members.member: The passive annotations applied to the method, in source order, as [FSAnnotation] descriptors. Empty when the method has no annotations. Each call returns an independent snapshot.

The exact FoundryScript types the parameters were declared with, in declaration order and parallel to [member args]. Unlike the [enum Variant.Type] carried by each [member args] entry, these keep the declared integer width and the element, key, and value types of a typed container, so an [code]Array[int][/code] parameter and an [code]Array[long][/code] one stay distinguishable. The names come from the compiled declaration, never from a passed value. Empty for a native method, which has no FoundryScript declaration to name. An integer parameter that declares no width names the full range its carrier spans ([code]"long"[/code] or [code]"ulong"[/code]), and a generic type parameter names [code]"Variant"[/code] because it is erased before execution.
The method's parameter descriptors, in declaration order, each in the same [Dictionary] shape as an [method Object.get_method_list] argument.
The trailing default argument values declared for the method, in declaration order.
The method's flags, a bitmask of [enum MethodFlags] values.

The exact FoundryScript type the return value was declared with, following the same rules as [member arg_type_names]. Empty for a native method. A method that returns no value is named [code]void[/code], matching the return type keyword. This covers a method declared [code]-> void[/code] as well as one with no declared return type whose body has no [code]return[/code] statement, since both return nothing. A method with no declared return type that does return a value is named [code skip-lint]Variant[/code].
The method's return value descriptor, in the same [Dictionary] shape as an [method Object.get_method_list] return value.
